blurb: Guests can choose from several boat tours including sunset cruises, day and night sightseeing, and private charters. Tours feature views of Miami's skyline, celebrity waterfront homes, and Biscayne Bay. Some cruises include unlimited drinks and bilingual guides.
extraNote: 72-hour cancellation policy for full refund if cancelled at least 72 hours before tour · No late boarding; boat departs on time · Payment by debit or credit cards (Amex, Visa, MasterCard, Discover) · Prices include all taxes and levies · Miamarina At Bayside for most tours; Downtown Miami marina for night cruise · Year-round
